About 20 blocks to place here, some 12 seconds of building; the nearest spider, 3 blocks off, can be at the bot in about 0 seconds. Something that bites is at arm's length now, and it hits freely while the blocks go down. About 29.5 damage from the mobs here in the next fifteen seconds this way, the 1.2 seconds of placing it included, from 13.3 health (more than the bot has). Behind it, the spider and the zombie still reach it.

walk_route.description: Walk the pathfinder's route to the fortress, 9 blocks off and 8 blocks up: to a point level with the bot above it first, then to the bricks' own height if that comes no nearer. On top a push is a fall of up to 8 blocks, about 5 health. In sight: a piglin 29 blocks off.

Tried on this approach once and ended no nearer: The staircase toward (247, 56, 193) is set aside (backed off to a landing at (254, 49, 199) with no step toward it there either (no floor 3, a deadly drop beside the step 1)); trying another way.

keep_searching.description: Leave this fortress for ten minutes and go on with the search from here (15 legs so far, 1 minutes on this one): the sweep goes on along its heading, and the fortress may be met again from another side.
